articles.title: Did You Know a Giant Ice Cream Scoop Weighed More Than a Car?
articles.summary: July is National Ice Cream Month, and the USA celebrates with wild facts. A single scoop once weighed 3,010 pounds—that's heavier than a small car! Plus, your favorite flavor might reveal your personality.

articles.title: Match Point Thriller: Muchova's Epic Comeback Stuns Gauff at Wimbledon
articles.summary: Karolina Muchova saved a match point and won a nail-biting tiebreak 12-10 to beat Coco Gauff at Wimbledon. After 2 hours 35 minutes, she buried her face in a towel, shaking with joy.

articles.title: Whoa! The Milky Way Might Be Way Bigger and Lopsided Like a Snail Shell
articles.summary: Scientists used echoes from giant space explosions to measure our galaxy's arms. They found two arms are 10% farther away than we thought, making the Milky Way bigger and more lopsided—like a snail's shell!
